input.sql: SELECT l.status FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.types = 'Artifact' AND c.side IS NULL AND l.format = 'vintage' LIMIT 200
SELECT l.status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.types = 'Artifact' AND c.side IS NULL AND l.format = 'vintage' GROUP BY l.status

part.text:
For artifact-type cards (`types = 'Artifact'`) that do not have multiple faces on the same card (`side IS NULL`), their legalities status for the vintage play format (`format = 'vintage'`) includes three distinct statuses:

| Status | Count |
|---|---|
| Legal | 3,645 |
| Restricted | 151 |
| Banned | 14 |

These 3,810 artifact cards (without multiple faces) are mostly Legal in vintage, with 151 Restricted and 14 Banned.

Final Answer: The legalities status for vintage play format among artifact-type cards without multiple faces are: Legal (3,645 cards), Restricted (151 cards), and Banned (14 cards).
